general.title: L2P Analysis (Single)
general.instructions: START HERE: Fill in 'Basic Settings' to run with smart defaults. Advanced users can customize gene selection, pathway filtering, and visualization in the other sections.

datasets.name: DEG Table
datasets.help_text: DEG table with gene names, fold changes, and statistical measures

categories.name: Column Overrides
categories.help_text: Override auto-detected column names if needed

parameters.name: Comparison
parameters.help_text: Which comparison to analyze (e.g., 'B-A', 'C-A', 'Treatment-Control'). Must match column prefix in your DEG table

parameters.name: Species
parameters.help_text: Gene annotation species. Non-human genes will be converted to human orthologs

parameters.name: Pathway Collections
parameters.help_text: Comma-separated pathway collections: GO, REACTOME, KEGG, PANTH, PID, BIOCYC, WikiPathways, H, C1-C8 (MSigDB)

parameters.name: Gene Name Column
parameters.help_text: Override auto-detected gene name column (e.g., 'Gene', 'symbol'). Leave blank to auto-detect

parameters.name: Ranking Column
parameters.help_text: Override ranking column if not named '{comparison}_tstat'. Leave blank to auto-detect

parameters.name: Significance Column
parameters.help_text: Override significance/p-value column if not named '{comparison}_pval'. Leave blank to auto-detect

parameters.name: Fold Change Column
parameters.help_text: Override fold change column if not named '{comparison}_FC'. Leave blank to auto-detect

parameters.name: Select By Rank
parameters.help_text: Select genes by rank (recommended) or by significance/fold change thresholds

parameters.name: Select Top Percentage
parameters.help_text: Select top percentage of genes (vs fixed number)

parameters.name: Select Top Genes
parameters.help_text: Number of top genes to select (if not using percentage)

parameters.name: Significance Threshold
parameters.help_text: Significance threshold for gene selection (if not using rank)

parameters.name: Fold Change Threshold
parameters.help_text: Fold change threshold for gene selection (if not using rank)

parameters.name: Minimum DEG Genes
parameters.help_text: Minimum number of DEG genes required

parameters.name: Minimum Pathway Hits
parameters.help_text: Minimum genes required per pathway to be considered

parameters.name: P-value Threshold for Output
parameters.help_text: Filter output to pathways below this p-value threshold (0 = include all)

parameters.name: Use Built-in Gene Universe
parameters.help_text: Use built-in gene universe instead of detected genes

parameters.name: Use FDR P-values
parameters.help_text: Use FDR-adjusted p-values for pathway significance

parameters.name: Number of Pathways to Plot
parameters.help_text: Number of top pathways to display in plots

parameters.name: Pathway Label Max Length
parameters.help_text: Maximum characters for pathway labels

parameters.name: Pathway Label Font Size
parameters.help_text: Font size for pathway axis labels

parameters.name: Plot Top Pathways Up
parameters.help_text: Plot top upregulated pathways

parameters.name: Custom Pathways Up
parameters.help_text: Comma-separated list of specific upregulated pathways to plot (overrides top selection)

parameters.name: Plot Top Pathways Down
parameters.help_text: Plot top downregulated pathways

parameters.name: Custom Pathways Down
parameters.help_text: Comma-separated list of specific downregulated pathways to plot (overrides top selection)

parameters.name: Sort Bubble Plot By
parameters.help_text: Variable to sort bubble plot by

parameters.name: Bubble Size Variable
parameters.help_text: Variable to use for bubble size

parameters.name: Bubble Color Variable
parameters.help_text: Variable to use for bubble color

parameters.name: Bubble Colors
parameters.help_text: Color scheme for bubble plots

parameters.name: Bar Plot Color
parameters.help_text: Color scheme for bar plots

parameters.name: Plot Width
parameters.help_text: Plot width in inches

parameters.name: Plot Height
parameters.help_text: Plot height in inches
